narrative.details:
In fact it does appear that we are in need of even more purple lotus, Champion. While my own studies have yet to determine a new useful application for the herb, there are tried and true methodologies yet to be employed.

I need you to once again go out into the field and collect at least twenty purple lotus samples. Return them to me here.
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Apothecary Jezel at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Excellent and precise work, adventurer. Your diligence is to be commended, as is your celerity. I will personally see to it that none of these purple lotus go to waste.

Thank you again, and should you come by more purple lotus do not hesitate to bring them to me with utmost haste.
